candidate_name: Black Sea (Sakarya field) LNG export/liquefaction -- no named project
sponsor_or_proposer: None named yet (regulatory enabler only; likely eventual sponsor is BOTAŞ/TPAO given Sakarya field ownership)
current_state: In October 2025 Türkiye amended its Natural Gas Market Law to permit liquefaction and export of natural gas, explicitly enabling future monetization of Black Sea (Sakarya field) gas as LNG. This is purely enabling legislation -- WebFetch of the primary source article confirms 'no concrete project is identified... these remain aspirational rather than announced projects.' No sponsor, site, FLNG vessel, or capacity has been named.
missing_threshold_elements: sponsor, approximate location/site, concrete development step (all three missing -- purely a legal/regulatory change)
watch_for: Any BOTAŞ/TPAO announcement naming a specific FLNG vessel, onshore liquefaction site, or capacity target tied to Sakarya or other Black Sea gas.
notes: Fails the Discovery add-bar (needs sponsor + approx location + concrete step); routed to monitor only, not new_terminals. Distinct from GEM's existing upstream 'Sakarya 1 Gas Phase (Türkiye)' gem.wiki entry, which tracks the offshore gas FIELD/production phase, not an LNG export terminal.
